_comment: One produced track, no effects: the film is cut to it. `showtime audio cuts --apply <project>` picks the excerpt (offset) whose swell lands on the end card and moves the scene changes onto its phrase starts; run it after every length or scene change. The track is fetched from the composer's site on first use and credited automatically (credits.txt, share.txt). Another track: `showtime audio music pick --for launch --dur <len>`, then `showtime audio cuts <id> --apply <project>`.
